package.name: mgg_map_octomap
package.description:
An OctoMap-backed implementation of mgg_core's MapInterface, replacing the ROS 1 voxblox map manager. The planner only ever queried ternary occupancy, so a TSDF was never required; see section 4 of ROS2_PORT_PLAN.md.
The OctomapMap class itself is free of ROS so it can be unit tested off-robot; the PointCloud2 and TF front end is separate.
